text: ポケモンの　ヤドンって　とぼけた　かんじ　でしょ！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　ヤドンって

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are talking about, like 'as for'. ヤドンって = 'Slowpoke, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜でしょう
patterns.explanation: でしょ, short for でしょう, asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'. かんじ　でしょ = 'it has that look, right?'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. とぼけた　かんじ = 'a dopey, spaced-out look'.
